Application Data.NAME: Smith & Associates Security Services
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Smith & Associates Security Services provides a range of security solutions, including unarmed on-site security personnel, mobile patrol services, and risk assessment consultations. Our team is composed of licensed professionals trained to uphold safety standards while ensuring the protection of client properties. We emphasize compliance with local regulations, including the use of properly licensed investigators and adherence to operational safety protocols. Our operations also include the installation and monitoring of central alarm systems for high-value properties, reinforcing our commitment to safeguarding client assets.
